integrity: Universal proof is analytic, using the published spherical rearrangement inequality plus a cap spectral argument and measure-preserving cap-pullback rigidity. An included standard-library checker performs only supplementary finite numerical comparisons. Historical-priority uncertainty for alternate formulations is explicitly retained.
limitations: The numerical inequality and the strict-decrease equality case are credited to the motivating published preprint. The added theorem classifies equality for continuous nonincreasing kernels without strict decrease; no claim is made for arbitrary jump kernels, where explicit nonorthogonal extremizers exist. No external independent scientific audit was carried out.
title: Rigidity of sharp spherical mean-width contraction for every continuous monotone zonal kernel
